entities.name: Counter Check Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to request the UE to verify the amount of data sent/received on each DRB. The UE checks if the most significant bits of the COUNT match with values indicated by the network.

entities.name: CounterCheck
entities.description: Message sent from network to UE to initiate counter check procedure.

entities.name: CounterCheckResponse
entities.description: Message sent from UE to network in response to CounterCheck message.

entities.name: DRB COUNT values
entities.description: COUNT values for each DRB used to verify data amount sent/received.

entities.name: Packet insertion detection
entities.description: Condition where the procedure enables detection of packet insertion by an intruder (man in the middle).

relations.description: Counter check procedure includes sending CounterCheck message from network to UE.
Counter check procedure includes sending CounterCheckResponse message from UE to network.
CounterCheck message contains DRB COUNT values for verification.
CounterCheckResponse message contains DRB COUNT values from UE.
